default.description: What the window's page is allowed to ask the toolkit for. Everything runtrol itself offers is a command in this crate and is not governed here; this list is only the toolkit's own surface. It grants one thing: listening for the events the window pushes a session's frames out on. Without it the page's listener is refused, and because that refusal arrives as a rejected promise rather than an exception, the conversation simply never appears and nothing anywhere says why. Measured.
